verdict.rationale: Missive's pricing page lists "Email, SMS, social accounts" as supported channels, and its developer tools include "custom channels" for adding other sources. Aircall integration also brings calls into the app. Support for non-email channels is claimed, but only as a bare pricing bullet with no setup or behavior detail. missing for 10: documentation of how SMS/social conversations work in the shared inbox, any evidence of WhatsApp or live chat support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
